name: go-datastructures-durable-cross-process-7b21
instr:
go-datastructures cannot durably checkpoint B+ tree, skip-list, x-fast trie, or y-fast trie iteration. Add portable continuations that marshal deterministically, survive byte-for-byte transport, and resume on equivalently reconstructed collections at the next logical value.

Reject truncated, extended, altered, corrupt, future-version, wrong-family, and unresolvable tokens with distinguishable errors supporting errors.Is in every family. ErrCorrupt is "corrupt continuation", ErrFamily is "continuation family mismatch", ErrVersion is "continuation version mismatch", ErrCodec is "continuation codec mismatch", and ErrPosition is "continuation position unavailable". Check codec identity before decoding and reject unsupported versions. Failed restoration must not change the destination collection, iterator values, or exhaustion observations.

B+ restoration must resume after the captured occurrence across leaf boundaries and reconstructed splits, distinguishing comparator-equal duplicates. Skip-list restoration must resume after the captured comparator without replay, using decoded identity and destination widths despite different randomized levels. Preserve positions of comparator-equal occurrences created by positional insertion; ordinary comparator-ordered insertion remains compatible.

Trie restoration requires the captured entry and same universe. Missing entries return ErrPosition and incompatible universes return ErrFamily. X-fast restoration must resolve the captured key e
